title: Made where?
text: Made where?. Not sure what happened when this was made. The zipper is off by a good 2 inches, but it hardly matters, the opening for the zipper is a good 4 inches less on each side than the pillow size. Why is this an issue you say? Because this means you are stuffing your body pillow into this pillow case... the pressure on the zipper means it's going to break. I give it a few uses and it will be junk. Since I need something now, I will live with it, but buying this means just what I am saying.
